in.rationale: The bounded Python sampled protocol has seven focused tests and saved pathwise traces; distribution refinement is separate.
in.scope: Covers the Python pathwise interpreter for the pinned sampled debate protocol at t=1, k=2, with the two hand-specified oracles true75 and false75 only. The tests and traces give no formal probability bound: scripted traces are possible ideal-draw paths, seeded traces are reproducible pseudorandom examples with no exact 3/5 guarantee, and the semantic refinement and ideal-draw distribution link to Lean are not proved here.
